cases.description: An <openai:generate> element is executable content (SCXML 1.0 section 4.10) that the namespace extension component executes where its block runs: it sends one Responses API request (POST {base}/responses) and, with location, assigns the reply text at location as a string after any sends.

The prompt is the prompt attribute, then promptexpr's string value, then the trimmed text of each <openai:prompt> child in document order, the non-empty parts joined with a line break, sent as the one user message. Without a part, or with a promptexpr that fails or is not a string, the element raises error.execution.

The request's first input is a system message holding the executing session's canonical session snapshot, taken at the executable-content point with data_model and transitions excluded; it shows the configuration the element's block observes.

The tools are one send_<event> function per event descriptor of the transitions the active configuration can take, in the order the snapshot lists them: "." becomes "_" and every other character outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] becomes "_"; foo.* and foo. name foo; * names no event; a name over 64 bytes, or one an earlier event already took, gets no function. Each has the optional string parameters target and delay.

Each function call the result carries is sent, in order, as the event the function names, routed as <send> routes it: target (none: the session's own external queue), delay (a CSS2 duration; the n-th delayed send of a session, counting from 0, gets the send id openai.send.<n>, which <cancel> takes), and as data the data argument, else every other argument as one object. Without location at least one call is required; with it the reply text is assigned after the sends.
